title: Super Dungeon
observed_goal: In the opening-menu screenshot, an explicit goal of starting a patrol/entering the next section is visible; game execution, the operational goal, and its outcome were not observed.
observed_controls: The page text states that the experience is best suited to keyboard + mouse and that gamepad and touch are also supported; acceptance or functionality of these inputs in the game was not confirmed.
The START PATROL, HOW TO PLAY, and SETTINGS buttons are visible in the opening menu; activation or the result of selecting them was not observed.
observed_core_loop: not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; the frames do not show a repeating game loop, character control, interaction, combat, or outcome.
progress_feedback: In two fallback frames, the loading text “OPENING THE HALL OF ORIGINS...” and a progress bar are visible; this is only loading feedback and does not count as game progress. Score, stage, or in-game progression feedback was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
decisions_risk_reward: not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; no playable decision, risk, reward, or trade-off was recorded in the frames.
rewards: not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; the card’s claim about rescuing classmates and chaining powers is only an official, unplaytested claim.
penalties_failure: not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; failure, damage, cost, or penalty is not visible in the recorded execution.
outcomes_replay: not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; winning, losing, the end of a loop, or a reason to replay was not observed.
onboarding: The opening menu shows the game title, a situation description, the START PATROL/HOW TO PLAY/SETTINGS options, and input-support text. The HOW TO PLAY page, interactive onboarding, and successful entry into the game were not observed.
visual_audio_accessibility: Visually, a 3D menu with text contrast against the background, text buttons, and a loading bar is visible. The page text states that gamepad and touch are supported. The actual audio status, accessibility settings, and functioning of these input methods were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; the console warned that AudioContext is permitted after a user gesture.
technical_clues: metadata says that a canvas with dimensions 1280×800 was present and that the other canvases had CSS width/height of zero; this is a technical clue and does not prove game behavior.
The console recorded a warning that AudioContext was not started without a user gesture; this is a technical clue about audio startup, not evidence of game execution.
The console recorded several fallback-to-software-WebGL warnings and a resource-loading error with a 403 response; the effect on the game was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
No engine marker or tuning constant candidate and no scanned script byte were recorded in metadata.
transferable_principles: A clear opening menu with a short goal and start/help/settings options can structure user entry.
Explicit visual feedback for loading status should be kept separate from feedback for the game’s own progress.
Support for multiple input methods has design value only when it is usable and verifiable in actual execution.
Card claims or introductory text should be reported separately from evidence of actual execution so that a frame change or loading state is not mistakenly treated as a game loop.
candle_climber_relevance: For Candle Climber, score/rank should reflect only game skill and performance, not a purchase or wallet.
No gameplay advantage should come from a purchase or wallet.
Avoid free brake, horizontal direction changes, and branch paths requiring new controls; if any are raised, examine them only as hypotheses requiring direct testing.

From these inputs, only the principle of separating loading feedback from progress and separating claims from confirmed execution can be transferred; no Candle Climber-specific mechanic is extracted from this game.
do_not_copy: Do not reproduce the visual identity, texts, names, setting, characters, or assets seen or claimed.
Avoid conclusions about controls, the loop, rewards, or failure based on a change between two frames or a loading page.
Do not present official, unplaytested claims as confirmed product behavior.

evidence.claim: In the load frame, the opening menu with the START PATROL, HOW TO PLAY, and SETTINGS options, a situation description, and the keyboard + mouse/gamepad/touch support wording is visible.
In the late frame, the same opening menu is visible, and entry into the game or an active loop is not observed.
The after_key_burst frame shows a loading page with the text OPENING THE HALL OF ORIGINS... and a progress bar; this frame does not prove an input outcome or active gameplay.
The after_combined_input frame also shows the same loading page with the text OPENING THE HALL OF ORIGINS...; a frame change alone does not establish input acceptance.

The page text says that something woke beneath the school after curfew and that the page is best suited to keyboard + mouse and supports gamepad and touch; this text does not confirm actual execution.
The official card describes breaking curfew, descending beneath the school, chaining powers, rescuing classmates, and confronting two bosses; none of these was playtested in the recorded execution.

metadata records capture status as partial, start_action as none, and interaction_visual_change_signal as null; the fallback screenshots originate from fallback-1, and differences between frames may be due to timing/animation.
metadata records an AudioContext warning, software WebGL fallback, and a resource with a 403 response; their effect on the experience was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.

limitations: Only this game’s input files were used; no web browsing or rerun was performed. The screenshot after_start timed out, the general keyboard sequence was skipped when a text/select input had focus, and after_key_burst and after_combined_input also timed out. metadata says controls_attempted is empty and start_action is none. The two fallback frames originate from fallback-1. There is no direct evidence of active gameplay, a complete loop, an outcome, a win, or a loss; the absence of elements in the opening frame also does not prove their absence from the game as a whole.
